pairs.title: TACACS+ or RADIUS?
pairs.rule: TACACS+ is TCP 49. RADIUS authentication is UDP 1812 and accounting is UDP 1813.

pairs.title: Co-channel or adjacent-channel?
pairs.rule: Same channel means devices take turns. Partly overlapping channels corrupt each other and are worse.

pairs.title: SSE or SASE?
pairs.rule: SSE is SWG plus CASB plus ZTNA plus FWaaS. SASE is SSE plus SD-WAN.

pairs.title: Control, data or management plane?
pairs.rule: Control builds the tables, data forwards using them, management is how you configure the device.

pairs.title: Administrative distance or metric?
pairs.rule: Administrative distance chooses between routing sources first. Metric only compares routes from the same source.

pairs.title: In-band or out-of-band?
pairs.rule: Out-of-band uses a path independent of production. A management VLAN on production switches is still in-band.

pairs.title: NAT gateway or internet gateway?
pairs.rule: A NAT gateway gives private subnets outbound-only access. An internet gateway connects public instances to the internet.

pairs.title: Cold, warm or hot site?
pairs.rule: Cold has space and power only, warm has hardware and restored data, hot is a full duplicate that takes over in minutes.
